question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Transitory**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Eternal .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Transitory** means something that lasts for a short duration or is temporary.
 
• The correct antonym of **Transitory** is **Eternal**, which means something that lasts forever or is permanent.
 
• Other options like **Fleeting**, **Momentary**, and **Temporary** are synonyms of **Transitory**, as they also refer to things that are short-lived or not permanent.

Correct answer: *Option 2 - Eternal.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms of Transitory:** Fleeting, Momentary, Temporary, Short-lived.
 
• **Antonyms of Transitory:** Eternal, Permanent, Everlasting.
